title: Mere Abbas Aajao
body:
mere abbas aajao mere abbas aajao
kaha zainab ne roro kar
mere abbas aajao
ye kaisa hai sitam ham par
<<DIVIDER>>
hai naize par sare sarwar
jala abid kabhi bistar
chhini jaati hai ab chadar
musibat se bacha jao
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina ko mila pursa
tamacho'n se yateemi ka
hai zinda'n mai wo ab tanha
bohat ghamdeeda hai dukhiya
<<DIVIDER>>
use dil se laga jao
bohat hai baar-e-gham bhai
kamar hai jaise qam bhai
hai eeza dam badam bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
khade hain kab se ham bhai
hame aakar bitha jao
hame pal pal rulaate hai'n
adu dar dar phiraate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
tamasha bhi banaate hain
sitam is darja dhaate hain
jiyu'n kaise batajao
charaghe gham ye kehta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisa qaid khana hai
andhera hi andhera hai
sakina ka janaza hai
lahad uski banajao
<<DIVIDER>>
rasan basta teri jaayi
khule sar aye mere bhai
bohat seh seh ke ruswai
sare darbar tak aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ek chadar dilajao
hamara naam lele ke
bhare darbaar me aise
ye zalim kehta hai ham se
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha'n hai'n chaahne wale
jalaal apna dikha jao
